card.name: Digit 1 in Bible verse numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (sometimes 2) that starts or continues a verse number after a chapter colon or dash in Bible citations, such as Rev. 19:11-16.

modes.label: Verse number start
modes.description: The digit 1 right after a chapter and colon in a scripture reference.

modes.label: Verse range end
modes.description: The digit 1 after a dash in a verse range, as the start of the ending verse.

card.plain: It lights up on the number 1 inside Bible verse references, like the 1 in Rev. 13:11-18.
